label: moves or travels to
definition: Person, group or organization X undertakes movement with geographic destination Y.
scope_notes: Includes: move/relocate/return/arrive/go/visit to Y; depart/leave for Y; temporary travel or organizational relocation; bare unqualified destination movement as textual support. Excludes: leave/withdraw from Y; mere presence/residence/death place; sports-event qualification or attendance as a nongeographic destination; membership or political control. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: explicitly hypothetical or proposed relocation; invasion-only boundary; geographic/team or theatrical metonymy. Permanent residence and completed arrival are not required. Do not import external history to reject an otherwise unqualified textual movement path.
